scope: All retained original observed events plus the three authorized rich3 invocations; exact namespace/run/kind/provider/event identity deduplication. Selected-generation costs are a separate population. Copies and offline replays add zero consumption.
limitations: Retained evidence coverage is not proof of an account-wide invoice. Missing historical usage, unsuccessful sends and unpriced events remain explicit; observed subtotals are not complete totals.
Prior failed case-05 V3 has a separate USD 0.05 planning hold, not an actual or native-priced charge. It does not replace its uncertain native event cost.
External Codex authoring/review/web assistance has unavailable token/billing records and is outside Planner/evaluator USD accounting. Actual source-only review limits are published separately.
Generation selections are retrospective cohorts, not all-history first-attempt completion rates.

Conflicting historical native price snapshots are exposed as price_conflict, not silently repriced; their amounts are excluded from the observed subtotal and make the complete reference total unavailable.
